name: punchwall-player-state
description: Validate the current authoritative fresh-player stat schema, defaults, Studio automation mutation path, and replicated Hero City HUD state.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game:GetService('ServerStorage'):WaitForChild('PunchWallAutomation',5) assert(c,'missing current Studio automation') local reset=c:Invoke('Reset') assert(reset.ok==true,'authoritative reset failed') local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] assert(p,'missing player') local l=p:WaitForChild('leaderstats',5) local r=p:WaitForChild('RPGStats',5) assert(l and r,'missing stat folders') local leaderNames={'Depth','Score','Power','Coins','Honor','WallLevel','WallXP','Rebirths'} local rpgNumberNames={'FistMastery','BreakSpeed','CritChance','Luck','FistMultiplier','PetMultiplier','TutorialStep','DailyBreaks','DailyQuestClaimed','PlaytimeSeconds','PlaytimeClaimed','HonorPowerBonus','LastSpinAt','SpinCredits','TrainingActive','TrainingUpdatedAt','LastHonorCycle','PetDropPity'} local rpgTextNames={'EquippedFist','Pet','OwnedFistsJSON','OwnedPremiumFistsJSON','OwnedPremiumPetsJSON','OwnedHonorItemsJSON','EquippedHonorItem','PetInventoryJSON','EquippedPetsJSON','DiscoveredPetsJSON','LockedPetsJSON','LastDailyDate','DailyQuestDate','SettingsJSON'} local missing={} for _,name in ipairs(leaderNames) do local v=l:FindFirstChild(name) if not (v and v:IsA('NumberValue')) then table.insert(missing,'leaderstats.'..name) end end for _,name in ipairs(rpgNumberNames) do local v=r:FindFirstChild(name) if not (v and v:IsA('NumberValue')) then table.insert(missing,'RPGStats.'..name) end end for _,name in ipairs(rpgTextNames) do local v=r:FindFirstChild(name) if not (v and v:IsA('StringValue')) then table.insert(missing,'RPGStats.'..name) end end local fresh=l.Power.Value==15 and l.Coins.Value==0 and l.Honor.Value==0 and l.Depth.Value==0 and l.Score.Value==0 and l.WallLevel.Value==1 and l.WallXP.Value==0 and l.Rebirths.Value==0 and r.FistMastery.Value==1 and r.BreakSpeed.Value==1 and r.CritChance.Value==5 and r.Luck.Value==1 and r.FistMultiplier.Value==1 and r.PetMultiplier.Value==0 and r.EquippedFist.Value=='Starter Glove' and r.Pet.Value=='None' and r.OwnedFistsJSON.Value=='["Starter Glove"]' assert(#missing==0 and fresh,'fresh authoritative schema/default mismatch') local seeded=c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=321,Coins=654,Depth=7,Score=987,WallLevel=4,DailyBreaks=3,DailyQuestDate=os.date("!%Y-%m-%d")}) local seededOk=seeded.ok==true and seeded.Power==321 and seeded.Coins==654 and seeded.Depth==7 and seeded.Score==987 and seeded.WallLevel==4 and seeded.DailyBreaks==3 assert(seededOk,'authoritative SetStats snapshot mismatch') return H:JSONEncode({schema=true,leaderNumbers=#leaderNames,rpgNumbers=#rpgNumberNames,rpgText=#rpgTextNames,fresh=fresh,seeded=seededOk,power=seeded.Power,coins=seeded.Coins,depth=seeded.Depth,score=seeded.Score,wallLevel=seeded.WallLevel,breaks=seeded.DailyBreaks,equippedFist=seeded.EquippedFist,pet=seeded.Pet})

steps.label: fresh authoritative schema defaults and seeded snapshot are current

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer assert(p,'missing local player') local l=p:WaitForChild('leaderstats',5) local r=p:WaitForChild('RPGStats',5) local g=p:WaitForChild('PlayerGui'):WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD',5) local h=g:WaitForChild('PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD',5) assert(l and r and g and h,'missing replicated player/HUD state') local power=h.PowerCard.PowerValue local coins=h.CoinsCard.CoinsValue local depth=h.WallCard.DepthValue local legacyPower=g.StatsPanel:FindFirstChild('Power',true) local legacyCoins=g.StatsPanel:FindFirstChild('Coins',true) local legacyWall=g.StatsPanel:FindFirstChild('WallLevel',true) local legacyFist=g.StatsPanel:FindFirstChild('EquippedFist',true) local legacyPet=g.StatsPanel:FindFirstChild('Pet',true) local legacyRebirth=g.StatsPanel:FindFirstChild('Rebirths',true) local rankStats=h.DepthRankHUD:FindFirstChild('RankStatsData') local marker=h.DepthRankHUD:FindFirstChild('HeroDepthMarker1',true) local markerName=marker and marker:FindFirstChild('HeroName') local stateExact=l.Power.Value==321 and l.Coins.Value==654 and l.Depth.Value==7 and l.Score.Value==987 and l.WallLevel.Value==4 and l.Rebirths.Value==0 and r.DailyBreaks.Value==3 and r.EquippedFist.Value=='Starter Glove' and r.Pet.Value=='None' local heroExact=power.Text=='321' and coins.Text=='654' and depth.Text=='7' and power.TextFits and coins.TextFits and depth.TextFits and h:GetAttribute('AuthoritativeDepth')==7 and h:GetAttribute('AuthoritativeQuestBreaks')==3 and h.QuestCard.QuestProgress.Text=='3 / 10' and string.find(h.NextWorldCard.WorldProgress.Text,'D7/75',1,true)~=nil and rankStats and string.find(rankStats.Text,'DEPTH 7',1,true)~=nil and string.find(rankStats.Text,'SCORE 987',1,true)~=nil and markerName and string.find(markerName.Text,'D7',1,true)~=nil local legacyExact=legacyPower and legacyPower.Text=='Power: 321' and legacyCoins and legacyCoins.Text=='Coins: 654' and legacyWall and string.find(legacyWall.Text,'Wall Lv: 4',1,true)==1 and legacyFist and legacyFist.Text=='Fist: Starter Fist' and legacyPet and legacyPet.Text=='Pets: None  x1.00' and legacyRebirth and legacyRebirth.Text=='Rebirths: 0  x1.00' local valid=stateExact and heroExact and legacyExact return H:JSONEncode({valid=valid,stateExact=stateExact,heroExact=heroExact,legacyExact=legacyExact,power=power.Text,coins=coins.Text,depth=depth.Text,quest=h.QuestCard.QuestProgress.Text,world=h.NextWorldCard.WorldProgress.Text,rank=rankStats and rankStats.Text or '',marker=markerName and markerName.Text or '',legacyFist=legacyFist and legacyFist.Text or '',legacyPet=legacyPet and legacyPet.Text or ''})

steps.label: current Hero City and legacy status labels mirror authoritative state
